items.note: the paper's own schematic of the ROI evaluation system: eight labelled input arrows carrying weights W1-W8 into three summing nodes. note: P-C-2016-50193-615bc62f, 24 A4 sheets (595x842): an unnumbered cover, the paper itself printed 'Page 2 of 22' through 'Page 22 of 22', then two unnumbered end sheets. Fourteen numbered exhibits - seven tables and seven figures - every one of them captioned in the text layer and every one of them placed by the caption itself. No measured region is a whole-page raster, no page is textless: the figures are small pasted raster images (Figure 1 one bitmap, Figure 2 two, Figures 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7 one each) and the tables are drawn with paths, so both kinds were read from crops. What the census turns on: the citation style is parenthetical and lagging - 'Figure(3)', 'Figure(4)', 'figure(6)', 'figure(7)' and 'table(7)' all print on the page AFTER the art - and nine of the fourteen exhibits are never named by number at all, only pointed at with 'as below', 'from above table', 'the following result' or not at all. Two captions are defective: Table 6 reuses Table 1's 'Missing data columns' over the fourteen-school recommendation list, and Figure 2 keeps the placeholder 'general title.'. Figure 5 is a seven-column table bound as a figure. One region is a fragment: the right-hand panel of Figure 2 shares one printed number with the left, so the pair is a single row.
